title: Make the Jube tax configuration RSL-aware
scope: Show RSL context in native Jube cases using supported configuration: read-only RSL claim reference, TIN, RSL status, RSL-owned scores and risk sets, statuses mapped to RSL's, and links back to the Vati case and RSL

acceptance.text: Native Jube cases show RSL references and RSL-owned scores read-only
Jube statuses map to the RSL status vocabulary; links back to Vati and RSL are permission-checked
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR
